name: Pebble Earbuds
promptName: Pebble-Form Wireless Earbuds and Charging Case
legacyNames: Pebble-Form Wireless Earbuds and Charging Case
description: A pair of stemless bean-shaped wireless earbuds in matte pale-stone grey, each carrying one small glossy charcoal touch disc set flush into its outer face inside a hairline machined ring, a pair of precisely drilled microphone pinholes at its base, and a pale silicone ear tip over a fine steel mesh nozzle, seated in a pebble-form charging case moulded in the same matte pale-stone soft-touch polymer: a flattened river pebble about 60 millimetres wide by 45 deep by 26 tall, its surfaces continuously curved with no flat spots or tangent breaks, split by one hairline parting line of perfectly even width where the lid meets the body, a bright polished micro-bevel catching light along the lid's outer lip, and a shallow thumb notch centred at the front edge.
subcategory: wireless earbuds with pebble-form charging case
materials: matte pale-stone grey soft-touch polymer case and bud bodies with a fine even micro-texture that reads as a soft wide specular rather than a hard highlight, glossy charcoal touch discs under a slightly domed cover set inside hairline machined rings, pale silicone ear tips over fine steel mesh nozzles, gold-tone plated charging pins seated in machined wells, a fully concealed steel hinge with no barrel standing proud of the shell
primaryColors: pale stone grey, charcoal touch discs, gold-tone contacts
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, engraving, or printing anywhere on the case lid, case body, bud housings, or touch discs; never render a third bud, a stem hanging from either bud, an extra well, a second status light, a visible hinge barrel proud of the shell, or an asymmetric pair, and never lose the single hairline parting line of even width where the lid meets the body; never render flat spots, tangent breaks, faceted planes, or a sharp unradiused edge anywhere on the shell, and never render the case as a square or rectangular box rather than a smooth continuously curved pebble; never swap the matte pale-stone soft-touch polymer for glossy plastic, metal, or a dark colourway, and never render the microphone pinholes as a smudge, a slot, or a painted dot rather than real drilled holes; never reproduce the silhouette, lid shape, bud form, or trade dress of any real audio or phone manufacturer's product Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: the smooth continuously curved pebble silhouette of the charging case at roughly 60 by 45 by 26 millimetres, its matte pale-stone soft-touch finish with a soft wide specular, the single hairline parting line of perfectly even width where the lid meets the body, the bright polished micro-bevel along the lid's outer lip, the shallow thumb notch centred at the front edge, the fully concealed hinge with no barrel proud of the shell, exactly two identical stemless bean-shaped buds each with one glossy charcoal touch disc set flush inside a hairline machined ring, one pale silicone ear tip over a fine steel mesh nozzle and two precisely drilled microphone pinholes at its base, two moulded wells each carrying two small gold-tone charging pins, one small round status light centred on the front face behind a flush light pipe and one USB-C port centred on the rear face in a chamfered machined cutout, and otherwise completely plain unmarked surfaces must read identically in every angle, same case proportions, bud size and well spacing throughout When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
